title: あえてベトナムで演説へ　高市首相、FOIP「第3弾」の狙いは
extracted_text: 高市早苗首相は1日、ベトナム、オーストラリア歴訪に向けて政府専用機で羽田空港を出発し、同日夜にハノイのノイバイ国際空港に到着した。ベトナムでは2日に演説を行い、日本外交の柱と位置づける「自由で開かれたインド太平洋（FOIP）」構想が提唱から10年を迎える機会に、重要物資の供給網（サプライチェーン）強化などの重要分野に取り組むと訴え、構想の「進化」を表明する。 「現下の中東情勢を踏まえたエネルギー安定供給や、重要鉱物などを含むサプライチェーンの強じん化について協力を確認する」 首相は出発に先立ち、首相公邸で記者団に歴訪の狙いをこう強調した。2日にベトナムの最高指導者トー・ラム共産党書記長（国家主席）ら、4日には豪州のアルバニージー首相と会談する予定で、豪州では経済安全保障分野で連携を強化する共同文書を発表する方向だ。5日に帰国する。 FOIPは2016年8月に安倍晋三首相（当時）が訪問先のケニアで提唱し、23年3月には岸田文雄首相（同）が経済協力などによる構想の推進計画を発表した。高市首相の演説は構想進化に向けた第3弾と位置づける。 日本は従来、「FOIPの一丁目一番地」（外務省幹部）と位置づける東南アジア諸国と航行の自由や法の支配、自由貿易を通じた連携を深めてきた。
translated_text: Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi departed from Haneda Airport on a government plane on the 1st for her visit to Vietnam and Australia, arriving at Noi Bai International Airport in Hanoi that evening. In Vietnam, on the 2nd, she will deliver a speech marking the 10th anniversary since the "Free and Open Indo-Pacific" (FOIP) concept was proposed, which is positioned as a pillar of Japanese diplomacy. She will call for efforts in important areas such as strengthening supply chains for essential goods, and express the "evolution" of the concept. "We will confirm cooperation on stable energy supply in light of the current Middle East situation and strengthening supply chains including critical minerals." The Prime Minister emphasized the aims of her visit to reporters at the official residence prior to departure. She is scheduled to meet with Vietnam's top leader, Communist Party Secretary General To Lam (who also serves as State President), on the 2nd, and Australian Prime Minister Albanese on the 4th. In Australia, they plan to release a joint document on strengthening cooperation in the economic security field. She will return to Japan on the 5th. FOIP was proposed by then Prime Minister Shinzo Abe in Kenya in August 2016 during his visit, and in March 2023, then Prime Minister Fumio Kishida announced a plan to promote the concept through economic cooperation. Prime Minister Takaichi's speech is positioned as the third phase toward the evolution of the concept. Japan has traditionally deepened cooperation with Southeast Asian countries, which the Foreign Ministry positions as "FOIP's top priority," through freedom of navigation, rule of law, and free trade.
title_en: Deliberately giving speech in Vietnam | Prime Minister Takaichi's aim of FOIP 'third phase'
